description: Fund Polymarket from the account's Arc home, exactly like app.felix.trade: move 5 to 25 USDC from the verified Arc home Safe to the SAME owner's Polygon wallet via Relay, then into the account's own Polymarket wallet as pUSD. The Safe must also hold a separate 1.00 USDC Felix network fee, paid atomically in the same owner-signed transaction; it is not refunded if Relay later returns the principal. Before signing, the client verifies the Relay order, solver, amounts, refunds and the exact Safe calls, then journals its signature. Select the account with use_child_account first. Reuse the same idempotency_key after a timeout; never start a new funding to work around an uncertain outcome.

amount_usd.description: Exact transfer principal, 5 to 25 USDC, at most six decimals. Excludes the additional 1.00 USDC Felix fee.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it to resume this exact funding.

minimum_credit_usd.description: Optional: refuse unless Relay signs at least this Polygon USDC.e credit.

name: fund_polymarket_from_arc
